title: GenomicsChain Tier-2 executed-R Verdict Record
description: Metadata-only record for a Tier-2 executed-R reproduction verdict (design v0.3 §7.3'). DISTINCT record type from job_manifest.schema.json — NOT a variant. Raw genomic inputs/outputs stay local; only hashes + verdict identity + attestation binding are recorded on-chain. input_files/output_files are HASHES-ONLY and OPTIONAL. Pre-1.0 (0.x); fields may change until promoted.

record_type.description: Record-type discriminator. Distinguishes Tier-2 verdicts from job_manifest job records in the same chain.

record_version.description: Schema version. Pre-1.0 (0.x) during Beta; bump freely on field changes.

jobspec_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JobSpec (env lock + data pins + pipeline). Server RECOMPUTES from submitted jobspec_json/ref and validates against the accepted Stage-2 subject (design v0.3 §5'(e)).

verdict.description: Tier-2 verdict vocabulary (design v0.3 §3, §4). executed-R semantics, NOT gc_reproduce determinism semantics.

trust_tier.description: Enforceable guarantee tier (design v0.3 §1b'). MVP: server enforces self_reported. self_reported = non-repudiable signed assertion of a CLAIMED run; execution NOT independently verified.

result_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted canonical list [{relative_path, sha256, size_bytes}] of fetched outputs, RECOMPUTED locally by the runner (design v0.3 §1a'). Not the backend-reported hash.

backend_result_hash.description: Optional backend-reported (e.g. Thoa) result hash. Divergence from result_hash -> verdict env_failed (transport/backend tamper).

source.description: Provenance of the comparison target. Only paper_declared (with resolvable citation) OR independently validated_by targets back a leaderboard verdict; llm_extracted/operator_supplied without independent validation are DIAGNOSTIC only (design v0.3 §1d').

source_citation.description: DOI / supplementary-table / figure reference the hosted side can spot-check.

validated_by.description: Independent validator identity (MUST differ from the submitter for leaderboard eligibility). null = unvalidated.

expected_output_sha256.description: Top-level copy of expected_output.sha256, part of the signed verdict identity (design v0.3 §5').

comparator_id.description: Comparator used, e.g. exact_sha256. Part of the signed identity + aggregation key.

backend_id.description: Execution backend that produced the result.

input_files.description: OPTIONAL, HASHES-ONLY. Metadata-only submit keeps raw data local.

evidence_sha256.description: Legacy field (v0.3 chain path). v0.4.1 uses result_evidence_sha256 in Synoptis evidence envelope.

result_evidence_sha256.description: sha256 of the Tier-2 result bundle (backend outputs, jobspec digest, output file list). Not a digest of the manifest itself (R4-F3).

leaderboard_eligible.description: Server-set eligibility CLAIM (impl-review I1 + R2-B). Under trust_tier=self_reported this is a SIGNED, NON-REPUDIABLE self-claim, NOT a verified fact: the member controls the run and self-asserts provenance. MVP grants the claim only when expected_output.source == paper_declared with a (signed) source_citation the server can later spot-check; validated_by alone does NOT confer eligibility (its independence is unverifiable in self_reported). All eligibility-governing provenance (source, validated_by, source_citation, target) is in the SIGNED verdict identity. Real verification is deferred to peer_verified / a validator-attestation registry.

backend_metadata.description: Optional backend-specific fields (thoa_job_id, etc.). Not signed.

operator.description: Operator identity envelope (same 3-mode oneOf as job_manifest). Leaderboard-contributing verdicts require signed mode (design v0.3 §8'); anonymous is excluded from consensus.
